Name: Outdoor Flooring Repaint - Smiley Faces
Author: jackolidus
Description:
This mod adds a few minor an inconspicuous smiley faces to the outdoor flooring.

I like to prank my boyfriend (kindly and gently) in our save file and so I added some very subtle smiley faces to some of the outdoor floor tiles. I don't think he'll ever even notice (I changed the entire exterior of my house and a few days later he asked, "Does your house look different?") but it's the thought that counts!

Manifest.Name: Smiles
Manifest.Description: Adds a few inconspicuous smiles as a prank.
